data.gender_notes: Keivandokht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of Persian origin, derived from the words 'Kievan' meaning city and 'Dokht' meaning daughter or princess. This name signifies a regal and powerful female presence. The name Keivandokht carries the meaning “Princess of the City” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Keivandokht usually hope their child will grow to embody princess of the city and live with faith, good character and purpose.
